senses.gloss_en: the action of divulging, revealing, blurting out something
to store, to stow away, to put away, to tidy away
to die down, to fade away
to charge or enter in a bill
to crush or pound — see also crush, pound
to jerk, to snatch (to suddenly move something in an unintended direction; e.g., a steering wheel)
to pull or strain (e.g., a muscle)
to contort a part of the body
to execute, to perform, to carry out
